items.html: Also, you will see there that there are two kinds of image in man: one is the image of Elohim, which is this one of pregnancy. And afterward, in Gadlut, he has the image of HaVaYaH; and see there how these Mochin, being Elohim from the phase of judgments, which are from the externality of ZA and from the externality of Tevuna, are not called Mochin except for the Mochin of Gadlut, which are HaVaYaH and complete mercy from the internality of AVI.
